name: Shuugaku Ryokou ★ Naisho no Koi
original_name: 修学旅行★ナイショの恋
source:
You’ve always gone to an all-girls school, so you couldn’t be more shocked when the principal announces that your school and an all-boys school will be going on a joint class trip! Suddenly, you find yourself in the same group as five of the cutest boys you’ve ever seen…

You’re traveling with your crush, so exciting things are bound to happen. You’ll be together on the bus, at the hotel, and spending your free time with one another; you’ll make sweet memories that will make your heart pound!

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voltage.g.sryoko.en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你一直就读于女子学校，所以当校长宣布你的学校和男子学校将进行联合班级旅行时，你感到无比震惊！突然，你发现自己和五个你见过的最可爱的男孩在同一组……

你正在和你喜欢的人一起旅行，所以激动人心的事情一定会发生。你们会一起在公共汽车上、在酒店里，一起度过空闲时间；你会留下甜蜜的回忆，让你心跳加速！
